_purpose: Single source of truth for what each logical model tier (and each external generation endpoint) concretely resolves to, plus its fallback chain. The durable substrate under model routing: on a model swap, edit THIS file, not the 85 skill frontmatters. Skills name a logical tier (recommended_model = opus|sonnet|haiku); this file says what that tier is today and what to fall back to.
_durability: MODEL-INDEPENDENT structure, MODEL-DEPENDENT values. The aliases, the tiers, and the fallback discipline are stable across model generations. The `concrete` ids and the external `endpoint`s are the swappable layer. On any change to a value here, re-run evals/ (the regression detector) to confirm the swap did not drop quality. That is what makes a model swap safe instead of silent.
_no_runtime_check: By deliberate decision (model-versioning-canon.md, v2.46): there is NO mandatory runtime availability check. It was dropped as too strict (latency, URL-down, false positives). This matrix is consulted at build/release (build-manifest validates aliases against it) and by the operator during the 3-6 month audit. The runtime simply routes the alias; if a tier is ever unavailable it degrades down its fallback chain, it never blocks.

opus.note: Used by the 7 heaviest skills (build-agent, compose-creative, decompose-ad, evaluate-concept, frame-regime, recompose-creative, weave-hooks). Falls back to sonnet: a degraded synthesis is better than a blocked one.

sonnet.capability: analytical, default tier for producers and orchestrators
sonnet.note: The default (62 skills). Falls back up to opus if available, else down to haiku.

haiku.note: Mechanical tier (16 skills). Falls back to sonnet.

fallback_rule: If a tier's concrete model is unavailable, route to the first available tier in its fallback chain, then that tier's chain, transitively. Degrade, never block. Any resulting quality regression is caught by evals/, not by a runtime gate.

image_edit.note: Endpoint is also declared per-skill in frontmatter permissions.external_apis[] (model-versioning-canon.md). This matrix is the cross-skill SSOT for the audit; the frontmatter is the per-skill declaration. They must agree (build-time check candidate).

audit.on_swap: Edit the concrete id or endpoint here, run python3.11 evals/eval-runner.py, confirm scores hold. If a score drops, the model-dependent prompting layer (exemplars, posture nudges) needs re-tuning for the new model, not the substrate.
